prompt: For each month end of 2025, finance wants LedgerLoop's MRR from subscriptions billed in euros (currency EUR) next to the MRR at the end of the same month of 2024. A subscription's MRR on a date is the sum of its subscription_events.mrr_delta_local with event_date on or before that date. Which query returns one row for each month end of 2025, with the columns month_end, mrr_eur and mrr_prev_year_eur?

options.text:
WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end of 2024 and 2025 (fx_rates holds every day)
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS month_end
  FROM fx_rates
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', rate_date)
), mrr AS (
  -- one row per month end
  SELECT m.month_end, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_eur
  FROM month_ends m
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.event_date <= m.month_end
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY m.month_end
)
SELECT m.month_end, m.mrr_eur, p.mrr_eur AS mrr_prev_year_eur
FROM mrr m
JOIN mrr p ON p.month_end = m.month_end - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
WHERE m.month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'

WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end of 2024 and 2025 (fx_rates holds every day)
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS month_end
  FROM fx_rates
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', rate_date)
), mrr AS (
  -- one row per month end
  SELECT m.month_end, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_eur
  FROM month_ends m
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.event_date <= m.month_end
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY m.month_end
)
SELECT m.month_end, m.mrr_eur, p.mrr_eur AS mrr_prev_year_eur
FROM mrr m
JOIN mrr p ON year(p.month_end) = year(m.month_end) - 1 AND month(p.month_end) = month(m.month_end)
WHERE m.month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'

WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end of 2024 and 2025 (fx_rates holds every day)
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS month_end
  FROM fx_rates
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', rate_date)
), mrr AS (
  -- one row per month end
  SELECT m.month_end, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_eur
  FROM month_ends m
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.event_date <= m.month_end
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY m.month_end
), compared AS (
  -- one row per month end
  SELECT month_end, mrr_eur, LAG(mrr_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_end) AS mrr_prev_year_eur
  FROM mrr
)
SELECT month_end, mrr_eur, mrr_prev_year_eur
FROM compared
WHERE month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'

WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end, December 2024 to December 2025 (fx_rates holds every day)
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS month_end
  FROM fx_rates
  WHERE rate_date >= DATE '2024-12-01'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', rate_date)
), mrr AS (
  -- one row per month end
  SELECT m.month_end, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_eur
  FROM month_ends m
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.event_date <= m.month_end
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY m.month_end
), compared AS (
  -- one row per month end
  SELECT month_end, mrr_eur, LAG(mrr_eur, 12) OVER (ORDER BY month_end) AS mrr_prev_year_eur
  FROM mrr
)
SELECT month_end, mrr_eur, mrr_prev_year_eur
FROM compared
WHERE month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'
